name: cycle-pack
title: Internal pay review decision pack
for_each: select id,code from review_cycles order by code

sections.title: Budget
sections.sql: select b.* from budget_summary b join review_cycles c on c.code=b.cycle where c.id=$1

sections.title: Proposals
sections.sql: select employee_code,name,manager,status,currency,baseline_cents,proposed_cents,bonus_cents,review_ref,agreement_ref from proposal_register where id in (select id from proposals where cycle_id=$1) order by employee_code
sections.note: For authorised HR review only. No payroll changes or employee communications are issued.

name: review-worksheet
title: Internal employee review worksheet
for_each: select p.id,e.employee_code from proposals p join people e on e.id=p.person_id order by e.employee_code

sections.title: Proposal and evidence
sections.note: Draft working paper. Not an offer, employment variation or total remuneration statement.

sections.title: Recorded history
sections.sql: select action,actor,detail,created_at from activity where entity_id=$1 order by created_at,id

name: agreement-chase
title: Internal agreement follow-up register
for_each: select id,code from review_cycles order by code

sections.title: Agreements still needed
sections.sql: select employee_code,name,manager,currency,proposed_cents,effective_on from proposal_register where id in (select id from proposals where cycle_id=$1) and status='approved' and agreement_ref is null
sections.note: The authorised employer records what was agreed. This worksheet sends nothing.
